name: Solidity Interprocedural Summary Manifests
description: C06 declared summary route demo: the in-process Solidity analyzer emits a declared mumei.sol-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 manifest for a one-contract unit, the reuse check partitions functions as reusable, and the strict whole-context accept gate echoes one function's declared summary.

harness_contract.intent: Demonstrate the declared sol-summaries route family end to end: emit the summary manifest, verify it against a fresh derivation, and accept one function under the strict whole-context gate.
artifact_contracts: Read inputs: scenarios/sol_summaries/demo_counter.sol and the sibling mumei-agent sol-summaries route commands.
No toolchain step: the analyzer runs in-process on tree-sitter, so every step is deterministic and none is SKIPPED for a missing external tool.
Generate evidence: emit_manifest.log, check_manifest.log, accept_summary.log, manifest.json, harness_state.json, result.json, and report.md.
Gate order: emit -> check -> accept; the check and accept steps consume only the manifest the emit step wrote, never the fresh derivation directly.
The emitted manifest is declared data: check re-derives summaries and partitions reusable/stale/missing functions, and accept refuses anything but an exact context match.
notes: The Solidity analyzer is source-analysis infrastructure, not a verifier; the demo routes it only through the declared sol-summaries family.
Every step runs the real route commands — the analyzer needs no provisioned toolchain, so no step fabricates output and no fixture payloads are recorded.

The accept step names a function (--function add) instead of a contract-qualified binding: manifest keys are DemoCounter.<name>, and a bare name resolves when unambiguous, so editing demo_counter.sol cannot silently desync a recorded payload.
budget_policy_fingerprint is sol-summaries-v1 for deterministic runs.

steps.name: Emit: declared summary manifest for demo_counter.sol
steps.artifact_contract: emit step must write {output_dir}/manifest.json holding one mumei.sol-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 manifest keyed to the declared unit's context_key.
steps.verifier_gate: sol-summaries exits 0, writes manifest.json, and the manifest's schema_version and context_key appear in the step output.

steps.name: Check: manifest reuse check against a fresh derivation
steps.artifact_contract: check step must emit mumei.sol-summary-check/v1 partitioning every declared function as reusable, stale or missing against a fresh derivation.
steps.verifier_gate: sol-summaries-check exits 0 and reports context_match true with both functions in reusable and empty stale/missing lists.

steps.name: Accept: strict whole-context gate on one declared summary
steps.artifact_contract: accept step must emit mumei.sol-summary-accept/v1 and echo the declared summary only under an exact whole-context match; a stale manifest must refuse.
steps.verifier_gate: sol-summaries-accept exits 0, reports accepted true for add, and echoes its declared summary.

intro: Step 1: sol-summaries emits a declared mumei.sol-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 manifest for demo_counter.sol...
Step 2: sol-summaries-check re-derives summaries and partitions reusable/stale/missing functions...
Step 3: sol-summaries-accept echoes one function's declared summary under the strict whole-context gate...
narrative.before: No declared summary manifest exists for the Solidity unit; every function is unassessed and nothing can be reused.
narrative.after: manifest.json records both function summaries keyed to the unit's context_key, the reuse check confirms both functions reusable, and the strict accept gate echoes add's declared summary.

pass.headline: Declared manifest emitted for demo_counter.sol
follow_up: schema_version mumei.sol-scalar-parameter-deps/v1 pins the manifest shape.
context_key binds the declared unit's bytes; each function is keyed as DemoCounter.<name>.
add's return_dependencies [0, 1] and next's call into add are recorded as declared data.
Step 2: Checking the manifest against a fresh derivation...

pass.headline: Reuse check: both functions reusable
follow_up: context_match true and stale/missing empty — the manifest reproduces verbatim.
reusable lists both function names for the host's freshness choice.
Step 3: Accepting one declared summary under the strict gate...

pass.headline: Strict accept: add's declared summary authorized
follow_up: accepted true requires the manifest's context_key to match the fresh unit exactly.
The echoed summary is identical to the declared record — no forgery channel.
Demo complete: emit -> check -> accept closes the declared summary loop.
